summary: Completed E2E testing of ENZI Batch B iteration 196: E2EE (End-to-End Encryption) features and LumiMessenger refactoring. All 21 backend tests passed (100%). All 12 frontend UI tests passed (100%). E2EE indicator shows in DM channels with Enable button, keys generate successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: e2ee.py: GET /lumi/e2ee/keys/status/me returns {enabled, has_public_key, updated_at}. POST /lumi/e2ee/enable marks user as E2EE-ready. POST /lumi/e2ee/disable removes keys from e2ee_keys collection.
e2ee.py: POST /lumi/e2ee/keys/publish stores JWK format public key in e2ee_keys collection with upsert. GET /lumi/e2ee/keys/{user_id} retrieves user's public key, returns 404 if not found.
e2ee.py: GET /lumi/e2ee/dm/{channel_id}/status checks if both DM participants have published keys. Returns {encrypted, my_key_published, partner_key_available, partner_id, partner_public_key}.
e2ee.js: Uses Web Crypto API ECDH P-256 for key generation. Keys stored in IndexedDB (enzi_e2ee database). generateKeyPair exports JWK format keys. deriveSharedKey creates AES-GCM 256-bit key.
E2EEIndicator.jsx: Shows 4 states - loading (Shield), encrypted (ShieldCheck green), not encrypted (ShieldX amber with Enable button), waiting for partner (Unlock). Has proper data-testids.
useEnziData.js: Custom hook extracts data loading logic from LumiMessenger - handles channels, DMs, unread counts, presence, invites, buckets, calendar, predictions, domain colleagues.
seed_data_creation: E2EE keys published for admin user during workflow test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch B E2EE features verified: 1) Backend APIs - GET /api/lumi/e2ee/keys/status/me returns user's E2EE status. POST /api/lumi/e2ee/enable/disable toggles E2EE. POST /api/lumi/e2ee/keys/publish stores public key. GET /api/lumi/e2ee/keys/{user_id} retrieves key. GET /api/lumi/e2ee/dm/{channel_id}/status checks DM encryption status. 2) Frontend - E2EEIndicator.jsx shows below chat header for DMs. States: 'Not encrypted' with Enable button, 'End-to-end encrypted' (green), 'Waiting for partner'. 3) useEnziData.js hook extracts all data loading from LumiMessenger. 4) e2ee.js utility uses Web Crypto API for ECDH key generation and AES-GCM encryption. Keys stored in IndexedDB. 5) Previous features still working: Bot Actions Bar, Predictive Navigation, Dashboard tiles.
